found.notes: Company-announced (Anthropic post 2023-05-23: 'We have raised $450 million in Series C funding led by Spark Capital with participation from Google, Salesforce Ventures, Sound Ventures, Zoom Ventures, and others'). Equity; no debt/convertible/secondary stated. Valuation was NOT disclosed by Anthropic. The only figure is a press report: The Information (March 2023, via Crunchbase News 2023-03-08) said a then-$300M round was at a $4.1B 'pre-investment' valuation; TechCrunch (2023-05-23) says Anthropic 'wouldn't disclose' the valuation and that $4.1B would not be surprising. So pre_usd_m=4100 is a reported pre-money for the planned $300M round, not confirmed for the final $450M; post-money is not reported (arithmetic only would be about 4,550 if the same pre-money held; do not rely on it). Separate Feb-2023 Google ~$300M investment is a different event (see Google claim).

found.notes: Company-announced (Anthropic post 2026-02-12): $30B Series G at $380B post-money, led by GIC and Coatue, co-led by D. E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ and MGX. Pre-money $350B is arithmetic (380 - 30) and is corroborated by a secondary report (trendingtopics.eu: 'pre-money valuation of 350 billion dollars') and by the Google April-2026 report that cites a $350B valuation; Anthropic's post states only the post-money. The round 'includes a portion of the previously announced investments from Microsoft and NVIDIA' (amounts not stated), so part of the $30B is the Nov-2025 Microsoft/NVIDIA commitments, not fresh third-party money. Amazon's 10-Q Q2-26 separately records a $5.0B investment in 'Series G nonvoting preferred stock' made in Q2 2026 (i.e. after the Feb 12 announcement), which indicates Series G-priced paper continued to be issued after the announced $30B; it is not part of the $30B unless Anthropic says so (it does not). Announced as completed; no secondary component stated.

found.notes: Company-announced (Anthropic post 2026-05-28): $65B Series H at $965B post-money, led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital; co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, GIC, ICONIQ and XN. Pre-money $900B is DERIVED (965 - 65); Crunchbase and Fortune both say pre-money is 'not stated'. IMPORTANT BASIS: the post says the round includes '$15 billion of previously committed investments from hyperscalers, including $5 billion from Amazon', so about $50B is non-hyperscaler money. Amazon's 10-Q Q2-26 independently confirms it invested $5.0B in Series H nonvoting preferred by exercising an option under its April-2026 financing arrangement (which cut the facility from $20.0B to $15.0B). The other $10B of the $15B is not attributed to a named company by Anthropic, TechCrunch or Fortune; Crunchbase mentions Google's $10B separately, and Alphabet's 10-Q shows $21.1B of Q2-2026 non-marketable purchases and $20.0B of remaining milestone-contingent commitments, which fits Google's $10B but Alphabet does not name Anthropic, so treat the Google attribution as an inference. No secondary or debt component stated (Fortune: 'not stated'). Announced as raised.
